title: Data center backlash is uniting America
hook_text: Data centers are uniting American voters
script:
Data centers are sparking fierce local opposition in communities across the United States.
The rapid buildout of these massive server storage facilities requires heavy infrastructure construction.
Voters are activating around the massive expenses and physical changes coming with them.
This local pushback has now become a major issue in many congressional races.
Communities are pushing back against the power and water demands of these server hubs.
How is your congressional district handling new server facilities?
